messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: last night's GPU autoscale blip (23:10 UTC). Summary: demand spike exhausted reserved capacity in eu-west, scheduler delayed scale-up by ~2m due to pending pod gc. Need owners for quota bump, scheduler tuning, headroom playbook, and batch-job throttling. @channel quick owners?

alex: I can own the quota bump. I'll open an infra PR to request a 20% increase on reserved GPU quota for prod-eu and prod-us-west. ETA: Wed EOD. Tracking: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4210

kevin: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: repro in staging, test kube-scheduler flag tweaks and descheduler window adjustments. Prototype idea: try changing scheduler worker threads and reduce descheduler eviction window. I'll share test plan and perf numbers by Fri.

jordan: I'll write the headroom playbook/runbook. Proposed default: 15% GPU headroom on reserved pools, daily headroom metric + weekly digest, and an alert `redwood_capacity_headroom_breach`. Will add a canary run for autoscale fallback and a rollback path.

luis: Recurring pattern: batch jobs starting ~09:00 UTC are the biggest spike source. I'll work with the batch team to add windowing and stagger cron starts; propose a queue-throttling knob for heavy jobs. Assigning follow-up to data infra.

sre-bot: Created tracker INFRA-1987 and linked PRs: https://our-issue-tracker/internal/INFRA-1987 :white_check_mark:

alex: Quick quota request snippet for the infra PR: ```terraform
resource "aws_servicequotas_quota_request" "gpu_quota" {
  service_code = "ec2"
  quota_code   = "L-ABCDEF"
  value        = 120
}
```

kevin: For scheduler tests, I'll run `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on a staging node and measure pod scheduling latency + kube-apiserver metrics. Will post perf logs to the tracker.

maria: Assigning deadlines: quota PR (alex) Wed EOD; scheduler patch (kevin) Fri EOD; headroom runbook (jordan) Mon; batch scheduling proposal (luis) Tue. Check-in scheduled next Wed 10:00 UTC. @all please add blockers here.

jordan: :thumbsup: Added calendar invite and will include rollback steps for the quota bump if there is an unexpected cost spike.

luis: :eyes: Coordinating with batch team now, will link JIRA once created.

maria: I'll update the postmortem with owners and link INFRA-1987. Thanks team :rocket:
